action.objective: Verify e1e3 as a candidate: central rook relocation with king-side pawn safety and pressure on the e-file.
action.rationale: Broad depth-1 search suggested e1e3 at exact +97 but only depth 1. e1e4 also legal (rook to e4) but e3 keeps the rook active off the back rank and attacks nothing hanging; need a full single-candidate verification at max_depth 4 to check Black replies, especially tactics on h4/g4 and the Black rook on h5. Use reserved_candidate allowance of 2000 nodes.
